decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet stays close to the firm's textile and interior know-how, so the firm can keep interpreting market response and refining it within the collection, though carpet collections rotate fairly often.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws on deep material and craftsmanship expertise that lets the firm assimilate feedback and hold it in its premium range.
It is closely related to existing carpets and backed by designer collaborations, but overlap with similar decorative carpets makes it a moderate candidate for pruning.
The corner bench extends the firm's core seating competence and customization skills for residential and hospitality projects, making it easy to adapt and sustain.
The low-pile carpet fits the textile offering, but several parallel carpet launches raise the chance of collection rationalization.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line builds on core seating knowledge across workplace and residential markets, so the firm can interpret results and improve the models effectively.
